description: An org chart should answer two questions in a second: who reports to whom, and how big each team is. With a large organisation, most charts either shrink to text nobody can read or need a separate column for every level. Org Chart by TCViz is free — every feature, no licence, no limit on people, no watermark. Two columns draw it: the employee ID and the manager ID, at any depth. Add names, job titles, departments and photos, and it opens as many levels as fit on screen with every name still readable. FIND ANYONE IN A LARGE ORGANISATION • Opens as many levels as fit with readable names; each folded card shows how many people report to it • Open or close one level at a time, or one branch, or everything • Show only one team, with a breadcrumb (Everyone › CEO › CFO) to go back up • Search by name, job title, department or ID: the branch opens and the person is marked • Zoom, pan, fit to view and a minimap • Compact layout: people without reports are listed under their manager, so wide teams fit THE CARDS • Photo or initials, name, job title, department • Team size: direct reports, whole team, or both • A measure on each card (cost, FTE, sales) and added up for each manager's team • Vacancies from rows without a name • Dotted-line managers for matrix teams, drawn as a second dashed link LOOK • Style templates: Clean, Corporate, Colorful, Minimal, Compact • Colour by department, by…
